annotations.title: Fix Verilog that does not build

description: Fixes Verilog that does not compile or gives warnings, such as syntax errors, width mismatches or unintended latches. Builds it with Yosys and Verilator, corrects it, and builds it again after each change. Returns the corrected code, anything still wrong, and a link that opens it with its diagram. Counts toward the daily design limit, except when the code already builds clean (then nothing is changed).

code.description: The Verilog source code, one or more modules (at most 20,000 characters).
